translation: Green water pours into the pupil; fly shadows fly across; the pupil spirit is broad and large; there is redness encircling the wheel; the pupil spirit is scorched and small; excessive loss of blood causes dimness; the pupil spirit turns backward; one can see far but not near; the pupil spirit is defective; one can see near but not far; the pupil spirit is broken; women have fetal wind; the pupil spirit is empty and scattered; reversed menstruation causes blood to issue; flowers arise on sitting and rising; children have smallpox films; green blindness and film barriers; children have malnutrition injury; cold tears issue from time to time; black mist veils the sky; dizziness turns the eyeball; night blindness breaks out at night; black wind breaks out from time to time; one cannot see for long.
translator_notes: 抱輪紅 (baolunhong) is redness encircling the eye wheel.
瞳神返背 (tongshen fanbei) is the pupil turning backward.
倒經 (daojing) is reversed menstruation, blood issuing from the nose or elsewhere.
烏風 (wufeng) is a type of eye disease.
